question: A 24-day-old infant girl is brought to the emergency department because of a 2-hour history of fever, vomiting, and diarrhea. She has fed less and has had decreased urine output for 1 day. She was born at 33 weeks' gestation and weighed 1400-g (3-lb 1-oz). Her diet consists of breast milk and cow milk protein-based formula. Examination shows abdominal rigidity, distention, and absent bowel sounds. Test of the stool for occult blood is positive. An x-ray of the abdomen shows gas within the intestinal wall and the peritoneal cavity. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
